changes.from: Maker is 合十思维（北京）科技 (Heshi Siwei, brand 'Namaste'), Beijing. No maker-owned website found; confirmed via the maker's own WRC 2026 exhibitor listing and a Science and Technology Daily launch report (29 May 2026). Full-size biped running 'Wujie OS' dual-brain system. No official numeric specs found.
changes.to: Maker site hsswai.com (合十思维（北京）科技, brand 'Namaste') found and opened 2026-11-17: its Humanoid-X parameter block states 168 cm, 57 kg, 56 DoF, 50 kg payload, 5.4 km/h (=1.5 m/s), 48 V, 8 h runtime, 350 N·m peak joint torque, RGBD camera, motor-driven; head module is a 250 mm unit with 3D LiDAR + depth camera. CONFLICT: the same page's full-body module breakdown gives 1750 mm tall, 500 mm wide, about 47 kg and 41 DoF, and the WRC 2026 maker brochure repeats both sets (168 cm/57 kg/56 DoF in its parameter table vs 1750 mm/≈47 kg/41 DoF in its full-body spec). Stored values are the headline parameter block that matches the launch brochure's parameter table; the 1750 mm/41 DoF figures are recorded here. Battery capacity is stated only as 48 V (no Ah/Wh), so battery_wh stays null.
